set -eu; TS=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ); SRC=/workspace/carrier_worktree/vps_bridge/payloads/omega; [ -d "$SRC" ] || SRC=/workspace/clay-global-research-entity/vps_bridge/payloads/omega; echo SOURCE=$SRC; test -f "$SRC/runtime_daemon.py"; if [ -d /workspace/omega_runtime/pkg ] && [ -n "$(find /workspace/omega_runtime/pkg -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 2>/dev/null)" ]; then mkdir -p /workspace/omega_runtime_archive/$TS; cp -a /workspace/omega_runtime/pkg /workspace/omega_runtime/config /workspace/omega_runtime_archive/$TS/ 2>/dev/null || true; echo ARCHIVE=/workspace/omega_runtime_archive/$TS; fi; mkdir -p /workspace/omega_runtime/pkg /workspace/omega_runtime/config /workspace/omega_runtime/state; cp "$SRC/runtime_daemon.py" /workspace/omega_runtime/pkg/runtime_daemon.py; cp "$SRC/omega/router.py" /workspace/omega_runtime/pkg/router.py; cp "$SRC/organ_router.json" /workspace/omega_runtime/config/organ_router.json; touch /workspace/omega_runtime/pkg/__init__.py; python3 -m py_compile /workspace/omega_runtime/pkg/router.py /workspace/omega_runtime/pkg/runtime_daemon.py; PYTHONPATH=/workspace/omega_runtime/pkg OMEGA_RUNTIME_ROOT=/workspace/omega_runtime/state OMEGA_ROUTER_CONFIG=/workspace/omega_runtime/config/organ_router.json python3 - <<'PY'
from runtime_daemon import Omega
o=Omega(); e=o.start_epoch(); o.frame(e); print((o.root/'STATUS.json').read_text())
PY
if ! tmux has-session -t omega-grid 2>/dev/null; then tmux new-session -d -s omega-grid "cd /workspace/omega_runtime/pkg && env PYTHONPATH=/workspace/omega_runtime/pkg OMEGA_RUNTIME_ROOT=/workspace/omega_runtime/state OMEGA_ROUTER_CONFIG=/workspace/omega_runtime/config/organ_router.json OMEGA_GRID_INTERVAL=30 python3 runtime_daemon.py >>/workspace/omega_runtime/omega-grid.log 2>&1"; fi; sleep 2; echo '=== TMUX ==='; tmux list-sessions; echo '=== STATUS ==='; cat /workspace/omega_runtime/state/STATUS.json; echo '=== OUTBOX ==='; find /workspace/omega_runtime/state/outbox -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\n' | tail -n 20; echo '=== DB ==='; sqlite3 /workspace/omega_runtime/state/omega_runtime.sqlite3 'select count(*) frames from frame; select count(*) proposals from proposal; select count(*) effects from effect_intent;'
